item.title: Russian Forces Damage 5 Fuel Tanks at Yuzhny Port in Odessa Region - MoD
item.summary: MOSCOW (Sputnik) - The Russian armed forces, using drone strikes, hit five fuel and lubricant storage tanks and port facilities in the port of Yuzhny in the Odessa Region, where military cargo was being unloaded, the Russian Ministry of Defense said on Sunday.
